tidbit: Did you know… about 11,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Microsoft's new Maia 300 chip boosts efficiency and will roll out in 2027, making the company less reliant on Nvidia's GPUs. Confirmed by The Verge.
Reported by Fortune: OpenAI fired safety staff after claiming information leaks, despite promising independent evaluator access, showing why self-policing poses risks.
Lila Ibrahim from Google DeepMind explains that safety must be built into technology from the start to balance innovation and protection. Confirmed by CNBC.
INNO3D launches the AGS-4UMGX-R1 GPU server for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. Reported by TechPowerUp.
Wang Xingxing speculates GPT-6 could lead to robotics breakthrough in one to two years, still open per South China Morning Post.
Free every hour.
